name: pathfinding
description: Compute a navigation path through a dungeon map using BFS pathfinding. Supports 'swift' strategy (shortest path to treasure) and 'get_coins' strategy (greedily collect c7 coins on the way to treasure). The map is a 2D grid where 'wall' cells are impassable, 'treasure' is the goal, and all other cell types are walkable.

game_map.description: JSON string of a 2D array representing the dungeon map. Each cell is a string tile code: 'wall', 'start', 'treasure', 'normal', 'c1'-'c8', etc. Example: '[["normal","wall"],["treasure","normal"]]'

start_pos.description: JSON string of starting position as [row, col] (0-indexed). Example: '[0,0]'

strategy.description: Pathfinding strategy to use. 'swift' for shortest BFS path, 'get_coins' to greedily collect c7 coins first.
